title: Moonlight (play)
extracted_sentences: Moonlight is a play written by Harold Pinter, which premiered at the Almeida Theatre, in London, in September 1993 .

<blockquote>

(These rooms are in different locations.)
An area in which Bridget appears, through which Andy moves at night and where Jake, Fred and Bridge play their scene.
(Grove Press ed., n.
pag.

In counterpoint to their uncomprehending isolation between the extremes of the death before life and the death after is their younger sister, Bridget, who lightly bridges the gaps between youth and age, death and life.
(Back cover of the Grove Press ed.

) ANDY, a man in his fifties BEL, a woman of fifty JAKE, a man of twenty-eight FRED, a man of twenty-seven MARIA, a woman of fifty RALPH, a man in his fifties BRIDGET, a girl of sixteen (Grove Press ed., n.
pag.)
